_doc: Major private-sector buyers in Singapore likely to issue CR13/CR09/CW01 scope tenders. Most run procurement through SAP Ariba (Ariba Network) or their own supplier portals — register once, then watch each.

sap_ariba_buyers.name: CapitaLand Investment
sap_ariba_buyers.portfolio: Malls (CICT), industrial/logistics (CLAR), commercial offices — large R&R + waterproofing pipeline.

sap_ariba_buyers.name: Mapletree
sap_ariba_buyers.portfolio: MIT (industrial), MLT (logistics), MCT (commercial). Heavy roof waterproofing + facade R&R.

sap_ariba_buyers.name: Frasers Property
sap_ariba_buyers.portfolio: FCT (retail), FLCT (logistics), FH (hospitality). Periodic A&A across mall portfolio.

sap_ariba_buyers.name: Keppel
sap_ariba_buyers.portfolio: KCL (commercial), KIT (industrial), KREIT (offices). Office-block R&R + tower waterproofing.

sap_ariba_buyers.name: City Developments (CDL)
sap_ariba_buyers.portfolio: Residential + commercial property — A&A and rectification works.

sap_ariba_buyers.name: Singtel
sap_ariba_buyers.portfolio: Exchange buildings, data centres — waterproofing critical.

developer_and_reit_portals.name: Hongkong Land
developer_and_reit_portals.portfolio: Marina Bay Financial Centre, One Raffles Quay — premium office R&R.

developer_and_reit_portals.name: GuocoLand
developer_and_reit_portals.portfolio: Tanjong Pagar Centre, Guoco Tower — mixed-use.

developer_and_reit_portals.name: Far East Organization
developer_and_reit_portals.portfolio: Residential + hospitality + retail — large private-sector pipeline.

developer_and_reit_portals.name: Lendlease
developer_and_reit_portals.portfolio: Paya Lebar Quarter, Jem — retail-led mixed-use.

developer_and_reit_portals.name: OUE
developer_and_reit_portals.portfolio: OUE Bayfront, Mandarin Gallery — commercial + retail.

hospitality_buyers.name: Marina Bay Sands
hospitality_buyers.portfolio: Integrated resort — rolling R&R + waterproofing on a vast complex.

industrial_and_telco.name: Singtel data centres
industrial_and_telco.portfolio: DC roof + waterproofing — leak risk = revenue loss.

industrial_and_telco.name: Equinix / Digital Realty / STT GDC
industrial_and_telco.portfolio: Hyperscale DC building works — premium pricing on waterproofing.

industrial_and_telco.name: IHH / Parkway Pantai
industrial_and_telco.portfolio: Mount Elizabeth, Gleneagles, Parkway East — hospital R&R.
